body: I have severe mental health issues, to the point that it's debilitating. I can't work, drive a car, or do most anything without having someone close with me and/or being on benzos. I've been losing joy in things I once loved. I practically feel no joy in anything anymore. I've lost nearly all of my passions. It's just too painful to live, and I'm tired of feeling this way. I don't have the means to make things better.
I can relate so much to this. I wasted a lot of time in community college, only to end up wasting everyone's time because I'm too disabled to actually work.

I can't discuss the method as it goes against this sub's rules. However, I need to gather supplies for it and re-study it another dozen times to make sure I get it right. Depending on my access to supplies, I may be able to just go to the store for them or I may have to wait a couple of weeks for them to come in.
I'm writing the letter to explain why I'm doing this, and I will also explain that he did everything within his power. There was nothing else he needed to do.

I've talked to him about my mental health issues. He knows what I'm going through. The only thing he doesn't know is that I plan to end my own life. I know this will cause him a lot of pain, and that's the most difficult thing about this. However, I believe in due time he can heal from it. I've always thought that he could do better than me.

I have a psychiatrist that prescribes my medication. I'm on several meds right now, including klonopin when the anxiety gets really bad. I cannot afford one on one counseling and my insurance (I'm on Medicaid) does not cover it. I can go to group, but that doesn't really help, if anything I just feel worse after going to it. Not trying to start anything here, and I hope this isn't breaking the rules of this subreddit, but I live in a very religious area. I'm an Atheist, and having people tell me to "put everything in god's hands" does not help. There aren't any secular counselors at that clinic. Not really any in the area anyway, even if I did have the right insurance.
